about.p1: We built AI Language School because we wanted a simpler way to practice speaking — without schedules, awkward calls, or the fear of being judged.
about.p2: Telegram is always with you. A teacher-style bot is always ready. And a few minutes of real practice every day beats the perfect plan you never start.

items.q: How does AI Language School work?
items.a: You pick a teacher, send voice or text messages in Telegram, and receive corrected phrasing and feedback in real time.
